_description: Maps IR / incident projects to GRC risk IDs and attack paths. Read by /security-report to derive cross-source intelligence (incident evidence per risk).

mappings.ir_name: string — short codename for the IR project
mappings.ir_id: string — stable identifier from your IR ticketing system
mappings.priority: string | null — severity from your IR system
mappings.status: string — ticket status (Backlog | In Progress | Done | ...)
mappings.vanta_risk: string | array of strings — risk ID(s) from your GRC tool that this incident provides evidence for
mappings.attack_path: string | array of strings | null — attack-path ID(s) that this incident corroborates

_schema.unmapped_ir: Array of IR projects that don't yet map to a risk — surfaced in the dashboard for triage
_schema.stats: Aggregate counts used by the dashboard header tiles

_examples_only: The mappings below are illustrative placeholders. Replace ir_id with real IDs from your IR system and vanta_risk with the risk IDs from your GRC register.

mappings.summary: Targeted phishing campaign against finance team
Former employee retained access to CI/CD system
Compromised third-party CDN serving malicious JavaScript
